title: Copilot Studio: self-learning recommendations to refine agents
summary: The briefing accurately attributes the planned behaviour and stale target dates to the roadmap. The documented monthly credit-limit path and its limitations are supported; the background reasoning-model rate should be explicitly scoped to the standard harness and its licensing exclusions.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the unit used to measure Copilot Studio agent usage.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the documented surrounding agent-activity meter rather than a documented self-learning meter.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits measure agent usage. One interaction with an agent can consume several credits because each feature the agent uses in that interaction has its own rate.

claims.claim: Agent flows are predefined flow-action sequences for repetitive tasks without agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.
claims.quote: agent flows, which are predefined sequences of flow actions to execute repetitive tasks quickly, without requiring agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.

claims.claim: The cited billing page states a reasoning-model premium rate of 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.
claims.quote: It's billed as Text and generative AI tools (premium) per 1000 tokens, at 10 Copilot Credits.
claims.fix: Replace the reasoning-model rate sentence with: 'For billable standard-harness reasoning-model usage, the page lists an additional 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 billed tokens; eligible authenticated Microsoft 365 Copilot employee-facing usage is included in that licence, subject to fair usage limits and exclusions.' This is background pricing, not a verified rate for self-learning. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management.

claims.claim: The monthly agent-limit path is Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio.
2. Select Manage Agents.
3. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: No API for setting an individual agent's monthly Copilot Credit limit is documented in the references searched.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio per agent monthly consumption limit automation Power Platform API pac admin PowerShell Dataverse bot Set limit; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/entities/bot credit limit monthly. Read returned API, bot and capacity excerpts.

claims.claim: The agent hard stop is optional and is enabled using Stop usage.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: An agent's monthly credit limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.claim: The monthly limit is a general per-agent Copilot Studio consumption control, not a self-learning switch.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure a notification threshold with the monthly agent limit.
claims.quote:
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
5. Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: Agent credit consumption can be reviewed under Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents.
claims.quote:
On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. The Agents page appears where you can:

- Search for a specific agent.
- View all Copilot Studio agents across the tenant that incur billing charges.
- See configured copilot credit limits, if any.
- See month-to-date billed credits.

claims.claim: Agent flow consumption is tracked separately and can be reviewed.
claims.quote: To monitor credit consumption for agent flows, look for the Agent flow actions feature in the Copilot credit consumption details grid.
